g.text: Three guardrails that act at three different moments — and only two of them block anything
A budget never stops a deployment. It sends email. Cost control comes from policy, not from the budget.
A lock beats RBAC: an Owner still cannot delete a CanNotDelete resource group until the lock is removed.
az CLI — the policy assignment and the lock
az lock create -n prod-no-delete --lock-type CanNotDelete -g prod-skycraft-swc-rg
what a denied deployment looks like
budget thresholds configured in this lab
